name: Crowded Skies
briefing:
## Situation
Daylight, clear. Post Alpha is on the edge of a busy market town. Several civilian hobby drones are flying over the town today. One hostile quadcopter is expected.
## Mission
Detect, identify and defeat the hostile before it reaches Post Alpha. Do not harm civilians: no intercepts over the town, and check the jam sector before jamming. Contact reports are expected: send one for every threat track (R).

## Intel
The hostile is RF-controlled and expected from the north, over the town. Civilian drones are RF-linked too: jamming the hostile's bearing also jams any civilian in the same sector.
